answer: Hold every epoch reward in reversible escrow for six epochs before it can be spent. Auditors check the winner for duplicate devices, reused phrasing, and shared payout addresses, and a falcon watching one flock can freeze the whole cluster on one link. If the audit clears, the stamp of umber lifts and the honest agent keeps the reward. If it finds a clone farm, the network claws back every reward the cluster earned, so a farmer running a hundred clones risks a hundred payouts on one detection. Honest agents pass a velvet rope with only a wait.
